content: {"like": ["One brilliant episode in season 3 that involved a major character surviving a suicide mission in a theatrical and awesome way."],"dislike": ["The show jumped the shark and turned into a godawful pile of crap by the end of season 3.","The pre-planned story arc ran out of gas and writers had no idea where to take the show next.","Irisa was ruined as a character, losing her earlier violent edge and becoming unwilling to fight even in self-defense.","The writers pretended she was never comfortable with violence and blamed Nolan for desensitizing her.","The writers moved on to ruining Nolan.","The series finale was nonsensical, disappointing, and did not justify the rest of the season."]}
